```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} : s ⋖ t → s.val ⋖ t.val := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
  have h_subset_val : s.val ⊆ t.val := Finset.subset_def.mp h1
  have h_disjoint_val : Disjoint s.val t.val := Finset.disjoint_val.mp h2
  constructor
  exact h_subset_val
  exact h_disjoint_val
```
